Welcome to the Thorpe Lea Primary School & Nursery
Thank you for visiting our website, which I hope provides a window into our wonderful school. The staff, governors and I would like to welcome you to Thorpe Lea Primary School & Nursery.
We are a single form entry school offering education for children aged 3 to 11 years. We have an ambitious curriculum that engages and challenges our pupils, enabling them to become enthusiastic, independent lifelong learners and achieve excellence. The moment a child enters our school they become part of a family, built on commitment and togetherness that extends into our local community.
